rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun when experience means accumulated know-how, judgment, or life experience.

example.english: After doing this job for a few years, I had enough experience to train newcomers.
example.traditional: 做呢份工幾年，先至有足夠經驗帶新人。
example.jyutping: zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 gei2 nin4 sin1 zi3 jau5 zuk1 gau3 ging1 jim6 daai3 san1 jan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for undergoing events, periods, or difficult processes.

example.english: I had the experience of going through major surgery.
example.traditional: 我經歷過一次好大嘅手術。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ging1 lik6 gwo3 jat1 ci3 hou2 daai6 ge3 sau2 seot6

rows.note: Use this for having personally tried or done something before, especially in casual speech.

example.jyutping: ngo5 si3 gwo3 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this when the experience is an emotion, sensation, or personal feeling.

example.english: Have you had the experience of the pain of losing a loved one?
example.traditional: 你有冇感受過失去親人嗰種痛？
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 gam2 sau6 gwo3 sat1 heoi3 can1 jan4 go2 zung2 tung3

rows.note: Use this for personally experiencing an activity or situation, often with an emphasis on gaining firsthand knowledge.

example.english: We went to Japan to soak in hot springs and experience the local culture firsthand.
example.traditional: 我哋去日本浸溫泉，親身體驗下當地文化。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 zam3 wan1 cyun4 can1 san1 tai2 jim6 haa5 dong1 dei6 man4 faa3

rows.note: Use this for a particular event or episode that someone personally went through.

example.english: I still remember my experience of that fire.
example.traditional: 我到而家都仲記得嗰次火災嘅經歷。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung6 gei3 dak1 go2 ci3 fo2 zoi1 ge3 ging1 lik6

rows.note: Use this for the personal felt experience of trying, enjoying, or suffering something, rather than the event as a whole.

example.english: That night camping, I got to experience how relaxing it was to be without a phone.
example.traditional: 去露營嗰晚，我第一次體驗到冇手機係幾舒服。
example.jyutping: heoi3 lou6 jing4 go2 maan5 ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 tai2 jim6 dou2 mou5 sau2 gei1 hai6 gei2 syu1 fuk6
